answer: Start from typing cadence challenge on a fresh prompt. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 429 aliases would need 429 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The crystal test is the live device, the anchor test is the locked stake, and the echo test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
